title: Server rules command
description: A server side mod that adds a /rules command. Compleaty configurable.
body:
Server Rules is a lightweight Fabric server-side mod that allows players to easily view the rules of a server directly in-game.

Players can simply use the command /rules, and the server rules will be displayed in the chat. This makes it easy for new players to quickly understand the server guidelines without needing to check Discord, a website, or other external sources.

The rules are fully customizable through a config file. When the server starts for the first time, the mod automatically generates a configuration file inside the server’s config folder. Server owners can edit this file to change, remove, or add rules at any time.

The config also supports colour codes using “&”, allowing you to format the text, highlight important rules, or create clearer sections.

Server Rules is completely server-side, meaning players do not need to install the mod to use the command.

The goal of this mod is to keep things simple, clean, and easy to manage while making server rules accessible to everyone.
